parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for breast cancer. Filter drug_indication where max_phase_for_ind = 4 and the indication label contains 'breast cancer'. Join drug_indication to molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id and pref_name. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as INNER JOIN for canonical_smiles. Return columns: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (from drug_indication.efo_id), indication_label (from drug_indication.efo_term), max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
